sections.heading: What is trending: “gempa peru”
paragraphs: “gempa peru” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for ID (snapshot taken 2026-08-21T10:47:33+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 100 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage

list: “Gempa magnitudo 7,2 guncang Peru selatan” — ANTARA News Makassar
“Gempa M 6,7 Guncang Peru, Susul Gempa Dahsyat Kolombia-Venezuela” — CNBC Indonesia
“Gempa Bumi Berkekuatan M 6,7 Guncang Peru | Pusat Data Ekonomi dan Bisnis Indonesia | Databoks” — Databoks Katadata

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Fri, 21 Aug 2026 03:00:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-08-21T10:47:33+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-08-21T10:48:23+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
